items.question: Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
items.answer: Refunds are available up to 48 hours before the event starts. After this period, tickets are non-refundable. Please contact our support team for assistance.

items.question: Will there be security at the event?
items.answer: Yes, professional security personnel will be present throughout the event to ensure everyone's safety. Bag checks will be conducted at entry points.

items.question: Can I buy tickets at the door?
items.answer: Tickets may be available at the door subject to availability. However, we strongly recommend purchasing tickets online in advance to guarantee entry.

items.question: Is there a lost and found service for lost items?
items.answer: Yes, we have a dedicated lost and found station at the venue. If you lose an item, please visit the information desk or contact us after the event.

items.question: Are bags or backpacks allowed inside the venue?
items.answer: Small bags and purses are allowed but will be subject to security checks. Large backpacks and luggage are not permitted for safety reasons.

cancelOrder.question: How do I cancel my order?
cancelOrder.answer: You can cancel your order from the My Tickets section in your dashboard. Click on the event and select "Cancel Order". Refunds are subject to the event's refund policy.

findTickets.question: Where can I find my tickets?
findTickets.answer: Your tickets are available in the Dashboard under "My Tickets". You'll also receive them via email after purchase.

contactOrganizer.question: How do I contact an event organizer?
contactOrganizer.answer: On the event details page, scroll down to the "Meet your organiser" section where you'll find contact information.
